description: Labelled page-level set for the two known retrieval-quality gaps: vague attribute questions (headcount) and table/statement selection for comparison questions. Evidence pages are physical PDF page numbers verified against data/corpus_index.json; gold_answer is the verbatim value on that page. Labelling standard: the page must be the consolidated primary financial statement (statement of operations / income / cash flows / balance sheets), not an MD&A reproduction, a selected-financial-data summary, or a note. Used as a held-out validation set: the reranker-gate change was selected on data/domain_benchmark_cases.json, not on these cases.
